title: ロボティクス専門実験・演習B
subtitle: Robotics Major Lab/Exercises B
keywords: Electrical and electronic circuits 2.Vibration engineering 3.Control engineering 4.Robot control
educationalGoal: (1) Learn basic theory and method for robotics control. (2) Deepen understanding and develop robotics application capabilities. (3) Learn the skills needed to perform experiments and write reports. (4) Learn how to arrange and present the content, results, and discussion in a report.
advice: This is a course of lab exercises in robotics. We will cover the following topics: 1. Analog circuits Students will construct various circuits using operational amplifiers, observe the waveform change, and measure the frequency characteristics to understand the behavior of analog circuits. Students will learn the correspondence between theory and real circuits from observation and the results of measurement, which will deepen their understanding of control engineering. 2. Dynamic behavior Students will deepen their understanding of the basis of vibration analysis of one- and two-degree-of-freedom vibration systems. In particular, students will measure the amplitude and phase of a vibration system affected by time-varying force to measure the vibration of the experimental apparatus. Students will learn the basic theory of a dynamic vibration absorber. 3. Robot control 1 Students will learn the operation of robot simulator and then program a robotic arm. 4. Robot control 2 Students will learn feedback control and programming. A driving circuit and a computer will be installed on the robot that was built in the previous course, Engineering Exercises for Robotics I.

activityGoals.body: Complete lab exercises safely while following the prescribed steps.
Complete lab exercises proactively using on your knowledge of robotics.
Organize and discuss results using your knowledge of robotics.
Write and submit a report using the results, and explain the results orally.
